messages:
Ava - Content: quick sync — planning microcopy + launch posts + webinar hooks for the tri-mode pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need tiny, testable variants by EOD. asks: 1) 1-line hero per mode 2) 2 launch-post captions 3) webinar headline + 3 bullets 4) inbound routing map (form fields -> queues). who can grab which? :hourglass: 

Ben G: I can do the hero lines. thinking concise, benefit-first. will post 3 options each.

Maya (Growth): I’ll draft the launch posts and timing. prefer 2-day drip: announcement + demo invite. suggest A/B on “cost” vs “reliability” angle.

Samir (Product): For webinar bullets, tie to bench narratives: latency, cost/unit, and rollout flexibility. avoid absolute % claims unless we have benchmark doc. we can say: “up to Xx faster on common LLMs” as placeholder and swap later.

Joanne P (Ops): inbound routing draft: demo-request -> Enterprise SDR queue; trial signup with company email -> Growth leads; self-serve credits -> product onboarding flow; compliance questions -> solutions-eng triage. tiny mapping below:

```
form_type -> destination_queue
contact:demo -> sales-enterprise
signup:trial (company email) -> growth-sdr
signup:self-serve -> onboarding-bot
question:compliance -> solutions-eng
```

Maya (Growth): launch-post captions — quick drafts: 
- Post A (cost angle): “Cut inference cost without trading quality. See how Redwood optimizes serving across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Join our webinar -> [link]”
- Post B (reliability angle): “Keep LLM features online when it matters. Predictable latency, transparent costs, private deployments. RSVP for our demo + benchmarks -> [link]”

Ben G: hero one-liners — option set (pick one per mode):
Hosted API: “Ship LLM features fast — production-grade inference, zero ops.”
Dedicated: “Dedicated GPU capacity for predictable throughput and SLAs.”
Private: “Inference that stays behind your network — VPC & on-prem ready.”

Ava - Content: these are great — can you each add one alternate phrasing so we have A/B variants? small ask: keep each line under 8 words.

Samir (Product): webinar headline ideas: 
- “Serving LLMs at Scale: Benchmarks, Tradeoffs, and Best Practices”
- bullets: 
  - “What to measure: latency, cost/unit, and tail behavior”
  - “Serving patterns: hosted vs reserved vs private — when to pick each”
  - “Operational playbook: rollouts, fallbacks, and cost controls”

Joanne P (Ops): small ops note — if form includes "company size" > 500 or "compliance": set priority flag to enterprise; include utm for source so SDR knows event source.

Ava - Content: assigning: Ben — finalize hero variants + one alt each. Maya — publish two post drafts + schedule. Samir — finalize webinar headline + tighten bullets (no placeholders). Joanne — wire routing + update form fields. I’ll compile into the landing copy doc and push to #docs-review. deadline EOD PST. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Reminder — content push to staging scheduled at 18:00 PST once files are in /marketing/staging.

Maya (Growth): acked. I’ll drop the post copy + UTMs in here by 15:30.

Ben G: on it. will keep lines under 8 words and include a variant with a metric-forward hook.

Ava - Content: perfect — thanks team. will assemble and ping for quick signoff. :sparkles:
